insights.lede: What a year of your own data says. Each insight shows the sample behind it, so you can judge how far to trust it. These are patterns, not causes.

empty.body: Insights compare your daily health data with your activity. After a few more weeks of synced data, the first ones appear. Nothing shows until the data supports it.

reports.lede: Monday to Sunday, written up and set against the week before.
